Chapter 01① 性格与情绪

First Day at JB SchoolJB 学校的第一天

39 个词条★ 168 段

Leo Zhang moved to Bali last month. He is thirty-five, and he was a product manager in Shanghai. On his first morning at JB School, he felt anxious焦虑的. Everything was new, and nothing was familiar熟悉的. He wanted to say hello, but he hesitated犹豫 at the door. Then his teacher, Sonia, smiled at him. "Come in. Don't be scared害怕的. We are all friends here."

Leo Zhang 上个月搬到了巴厘岛。他三十五岁，以前在上海做产品经理。在 JB 学校的第一个早上，他很焦虑。一切都是新的，没有什么是熟悉的。他想打招呼，却在门口犹豫了。这时，老师 Sonia 对他笑了笑：“进来吧，别害怕。我们这里都是朋友。”

Sonia is a strict严格的 teacher, but she is also kind. She is serious严肃的 about homework, and she never lets students be rude粗鲁的. "In my class, everyone is polite有礼貌的," she said. "You can make mistakes. Just be honest简单的 / 诚实的 /…." Leo liked her simple简单的 / 诚实的 /… rules. She was also very straight简单的 / 诚实的 /… with him: "Your reading is good, but your speaking is weak弱的."

Sonia 是一位严格的老师，但她也很和气。她对作业很严肃，也从不允许学生粗鲁。“在我的班上，每个人都要有礼貌，”她说，“你们可以犯错，只要诚实就行。”Leo 喜欢她这些简单的规矩。她对他说话也很直率：“你的阅读不错，但口语比较弱。”

There were six students in the class. Kenji from Japan was very talkative爱说话的. He was an extrovert外向的人 and always energetic精力充沛的, even at eight in the morning. Ana from Spain was different. She was an introvert内向的人, a little shy害羞的 and reserved矜持的. But her notebook was full of beautiful drawings. She was very creative有创造力的.

班上有六个学生。来自日本的 Kenji 特别爱说话。他是个外向的人，永远精力充沛，就算早上八点也一样。来自西班牙的 Ana 不一样。她是个内向的人，有点害羞，也比较矜持。但她的笔记本里画满了漂亮的画。她很有创造力。

Kenji had a distinctive独特的 laugh. You could hear it from the street. Some days the class was lively热闹的 and fun. Other days, when Kenji and two Australian boys shouted, it was just noisy吵闹的. Leo was easy-going随和的, so he did not mind. "Leo is hard-working勤奋的 and very easy-going随和的," Sonia told the others.

Kenji 的笑声很有辨识度，在街上都能听见。有些日子课堂很热闹、很好玩；可当 Kenji 和两个澳大利亚男生一起大喊大叫时，就只剩吵闹了。Leo 性格随和，所以并不介意。“Leo 很勤奋，也很随和，”Sonia 对大家说。

In the break, Kenji showed Leo a video of a Muay Thai fight. "Is it too violent暴力的 for you?" he asked. Leo was a bit confused感到困惑的. "Why do people hit each other for fun?" "It looks violent暴力的, but the fighters are brave勇敢的 and fearless无所畏惧的," Kenji said. "And outside the ring, most of them are very mild温和的 people."

课间，Kenji 给 Leo 看了一段泰拳比赛的视频。“对你来说太暴力了吗？”他问。Leo 有点困惑：“人们为什么要为了好玩互相打？”“看起来很暴力，但选手们勇敢、无所畏惧，”Kenji 说，“而且下了拳台，他们大多数人都很温和。”

Then Leo told them a secret. "I have a phobia恐惧症 of deep water. In the sea, I am a coward胆小鬼." Everyone laughed, and Leo felt embarrassed尴尬的. "You are not a coward," Ana said quietly. "You are just sensitive敏感的. And you were brave勇敢的 enough to tell us." After that, Leo was not disappointed失望的 in himself anymore.

接着 Leo 说了一个秘密：“我有深水恐惧症。在海里，我就是个胆小鬼。”大家都笑了，Leo 觉得很尴尬。“你不是胆小鬼，”Ana 轻声说，“你只是比较敏感。而且你有勇气告诉我们。”从那以后，Leo 不再对自己失望了。

Leo looked at his new classmates. They seemed happy and free, and he felt a little envious嫉妒的. In Shanghai, he was never satisfied满意的 with his life. Now he wanted to be more open-minded思想开明的. Sonia gave him one piece of advice: "Be consistent一贯的. Come every day and persist一贯的. A good student is not selfish自私的 with ideas, and he is loyal忠诚的 to his goals. But don't be too obedient听话的. Ask questions!"

Leo 看着新同学们。他们看起来快乐又自由，他有点羡慕。在上海，他从来没有对自己的生活满意过。现在他想变得更开明一些。Sonia 给了他一条建议：“要始终如一。每天都来，坚持下去。好学生不会自私地藏着想法，并且忠于自己的目标。但也别太听话，要多提问！”

At the end of the day, Leo was not scared害怕的 or confused感到困惑的 anymore. The school already felt familiar熟悉的. Next time, he would not hesitate犹豫 to speak. He was still envious嫉妒的 of Kenji's energetic精力充沛的 style, but he liked his own quiet way too. Maybe he could be creative有创造力的 like Ana. "Tomorrow I will be serious严肃的," he thought, "and polite有礼貌的, and never rude粗鲁的, because my teacher is strict严格的!"

一天结束时，Leo 不再害怕，也不再困惑了。学校已经让他觉得熟悉。下一次，他不会再犹豫开口。他还是羡慕 Kenji 那种精力充沛的风格，但也喜欢自己安静的方式。也许他也能像 Ana 一样有创造力。“明天我要认真点，”他想，“要有礼貌，绝不粗鲁——因为我的老师很严格！”

Chapter 02① 性格与情绪

The Neighbour Next Door隔壁的邻居

38 个词条★ 128 段

Leo's house was next to a small warung, a local food shop. The owner, Pak Made, was a warm-hearted热心肠的 man. Every morning he said, "Good morning, neighbour! Are you hungry饥饿的?" Leo usually said yes. Pak Made was kind善良的 and patient耐心的, and his food was always good好的.

Leo 的房子挨着一家小 warung，也就是本地小吃店。店主 Pak Made 是个热心肠的人。每天早上他都会说：“早上好，邻居！饿了吗？”Leo 通常都说饿了。Pak Made 善良又有耐心，他做的饭总是很好吃。

Pak Made's daughter, Ketut, was eight and very naughty淘气的. One day she took Leo's shoes and hid them. Leo was annoyed恼火的. "This game is really annoying令人恼火的!" he said. But he did not get angry生气的. He needed patience耐心. In the end, Ketut gave the shoes back and laughed. "You are nice好的, Uncle Leo."

Pak Made 的女儿 Ketut 八岁，特别调皮。有一天她把 Leo 的鞋拿走藏了起来。Leo 很恼火：“这个游戏真烦人！”但他没有生气，他需要耐心。最后，Ketut 把鞋还了回来，笑着说：“Leo 叔叔，你人真好。”

The first weeks were not easy. Leo was often lonely孤独的 at night. He had no friends and no family here. Sometimes he sat at home and felt bored感到无聊的. TV was boring令人无聊的 because he did not understand the jokes. He was also stressed压力大的 about money and his visa. "Can I survive幸存 here alone?" he asked himself. "Should I quit退出 and go back?"

头几周并不容易。Leo 晚上常常觉得孤独。他在这里没有朋友，也没有家人。有时他坐在家里，觉得很无聊。电视也很无聊，因为他听不懂里面的笑话。他还为钱和签证的事压力很大。“我一个人能在这儿活下去吗？”他问自己，“要不要放弃回去？”

He told Sonia about his feelings. She listened and stayed calm平静的. "Living abroad is hard. You have to endure忍受 the first months. Many people tolerate容忍 it for a while and then go home. But you are independent独立的. Don't admit defeat认输 so early." Leo smiled. "OK. I can stand it忍受."

他把自己的感受告诉了 Sonia。她认真听着，一直很平静。“在国外生活很难。你得熬过最初几个月。很多人忍一阵子就回家了。但你很独立，别这么早认输。”Leo 笑了：“好，我能忍得住。”

Sonia also talked about the class. "There are two kinds of learners. An active student积极主动的学生 asks questions and speaks a lot. A passive student被动、安静的学生 just listens and waits. Leo, you are smart聪明的, but you have a wandering mind走神. In class, I often see you looking out of the window!" Leo felt silly, but he knew she was right.

Sonia 还聊到了课堂。“学习者有两种。积极主动的学生会提问、多开口；被动的学生只是听着、等着。Leo，你很聪明，但你容易走神。上课时我常看到你望着窗外！”Leo 觉得有点难为情，但他知道她说得对。

Pak Made gave him good advice too. "In Bali, we say: be chill放松. When you are relaxed放松的, life is easier. Go to the beach after class and unwind放松." He also said, "Most people here are good. There are some bad people坏人, like everywhere, but don't be cold to对某人冷淡 strangers because of them."

Pak Made 也给了他好建议。“在巴厘岛，我们说：放轻松点。人放松了，日子就好过。下课后去海边，松一口气。”他还说：“这里大多数人都很好。坏人哪儿都有一些，但别因为他们就对陌生人冷淡。”

One weekend, Leo saw something unbelievable难以置信的. Some boys were throwing stones at a dog. "Stop! That is cruel残忍的!" Leo shouted. The boys ran away. Ketut looked at him with big eyes. "Uncle Leo, you were so confident自信的!" For the first time in weeks, Leo felt confident自信的.

一个周末，Leo 看到了一件难以置信的事：几个男孩在朝一只狗扔石头。“住手！这太残忍了！”Leo 大喊。男孩们跑掉了。Ketut 睁大眼睛看着他：“Leo 叔叔，你刚才好自信！”几周以来，Leo 第一次觉得自己很自信。

That night, Leo wrote in his notebook: "I am not rich富有的. I am not famous. But hard work努力工作 can change my life. Bali is a unique独特的 place, and my life here will be unique独特的 too. I will be patient耐心的 with myself. When I am stressed压力大的, I will go to the beach. I can tolerate容忍 a few hard days. And I want to be warm-hearted热心肠的 like Pak Made."

那天晚上，Leo 在笔记本上写道：“我不富有，也不出名。但努力可以改变我的生活。巴厘岛是个独特的地方，我在这里的生活也会很独特。我会对自己有耐心。压力大的时候，我就去海边。几天难熬的日子，我忍得了。我也想像 Pak Made 一样热心肠。”

Chapter 03① 性格与情绪

But the other fighter got up. He was not beaten被打败 yet. Then something bad happened: he hit the young man with his head. "That's a headbutt用头撞! It's not allowed!" Kenji said. In the end, the referee gave the win to the young man. The other fighter had to accept defeat击败. He walked out, covered in sweat出汗. "Every punch用拳打 costs a lot of energy," Kenji said. Kenji told him about his family. "My uncle was a soldier. He jumped with a parachute降落伞·跳伞 / 弓箭手 many times. And my grandfather was an archer降落伞·跳伞 / 弓箭手 in a bow club." After class, Leo walked home past Pak Made's warung. Ketut was playing with the puppies. Pak Made waved. "Hungry, neighbour?" Leo smiled. Six months ago, he was a stranger here. Now he had a teacher, friends, a neighbour and a puppy. "Yes," he said in Indonesian. "And very happy."

"Don't be shy. Just have a try就试一试," Sonia said. "Smile, be polite and use some sugaring说好话；甜言蜜语地哄（课堂说法）: say nice things about the shop first. But remember the social rules社交规矩；社会规则. Don't push too hard. The seller needs to eat too." Ana added, "And if you buy ten, ask for a bulk price批发价."

“别害羞，就试一试，”Sonia 说，“微笑、有礼貌，再说点好话：先夸夸这家店。但要记住社交规矩，别砍得太狠，卖家也要吃饭。”Ana 补充道：“如果你买十件，就问能不能给批发价。”

On Saturday, Leo went to Sukawati market to buy shirts. The label标签 said 150,000 rupiah. Leo smiled. "Your shirts are beautiful. Can you give me a discount折扣?" The woman said, "OK, 10% off减价 X%（10% off＝打九折）." Leo asked again. "It depends on这取决于… how many you buy," she said.

In the end, Leo bought four shirts for 400,000. He felt successful成功的. "My cut off price砍下来的价格 was 100,000 a shirt!" he told Kenji. Kenji laughed. "Good. But did she trick骗；花招 you? I paid 80,000 last week." Leo did not know. But he enjoyed the game, and he felt less stress压力更小 than before.

最后，Leo 花四十万买了四件衬衫。他觉得自己很成功。“我砍到了十万一件！”他告诉 Kenji。Kenji 笑了：“不错。但她有没有骗你？我上周八万就买了。”Leo 不知道。但他享受这个过程，而且压力比以前小多了。

At the supermarket, things were different. There was no bargaining, but there were deals: buy 1 get 1 free买一送一, a voucher代金券 for your next visit and a coupon优惠券 for coffee. "This is a kind of trade交易；交换 too," Leo thought. "They give me a little, and I come back."

Leo saw a famous有名的 brand of shoes. They were twice the price of the shoes next to them. "Why double pay付双倍的钱 for the same shoes?" he asked Ana. "People pay for the name," she said. "For me, value价值；性价比 is more important than a brand."

Ana wanted to make videos in China. "Do I need a visa?" she asked Leo. "For UK people, China is visa-free免签的 for 30 days now," Leo said. Ana was happy. "Great. Last year my friend had a visa fail签证被拒（更自然：my visa was rejected） for another country. It was terrible."

Ana 想去中国拍视频。“我需要签证吗？”她问 Leo。“现在英国人去中国可以免签 30 天，”Leo 说。Ana 很高兴：“太好了。去年我朋友去另一个国家签证被拒了，可糟糕了。”

"What should I see in Beijing?" Ana asked. Leo said, "Climb The Great Wall长城. And get up early to watch the flag-raising升旗 at Tiananmen Square天安门广场. Many tourists go there at sunrise." Kenji said, "China has a very long history历史."

“我在北京该去看什么？”Ana 问。Leo 说：“去爬长城。再早点起床，去天安门广场看升旗。很多游客都在日出时去。”Kenji 说：“中国的历史非常悠久。”

Ana made a short video about her plan. She put no ads广告（advertisement 的缩写复数） in it. In one day, it got 2,000 likes（社交媒体）点赞. One fan wrote, "LOL（网络用语）大笑（= laugh out loud）, Ana, don't eat too much hot pot!" Ana laughed and showed Leo.

Ana 拍了一段关于旅行计划的短视频，里面没放任何广告。一天之内就收获了 2000 个赞。一个粉丝留言：“哈哈，Ana，别吃太多火锅哦！”Ana 笑着给 Leo 看。

At the end of the video, Ana said, "Travel helps people understand each other. That's good for world peace和平；平静." Leo smiled. "Now you sound like a teacher too."
